rounds.text: Market momentum and recent operational acceleration point to significant underlying strength that outpaces traditional multiple-based skepticism [E11, E12, E13]. The business displays remarkable price appreciation, delivering 341% growth over 1 year, 108% over 3 years, and 110% over 5 years [E11, E12, E13]. This massive momentum is underpinned by fundamental operational progress, specifically demonstrated by rising sales on a quarter-over-quarter basis [E24]. Furthermore, the company operates from a position of profound balance-sheet safety as it is flagged as almost debt free [E19]. Operating within a non-cyclical earnings profile, the firm provides steady baseline stability while riding healthy sector dynamics where median sales growth sits at 12.5% and median profit growth at 16.4% [E18, E27, E28]. Conceded: [E11], [E12], [E13], [E19], [E24], [E27], [E28]. The bull's heavy reliance on historical price momentum and quarter-over-quarter sales gains [E11, E12, E13, E24] completely ignores the catastrophic reality of a 435x P/E ratio against a sector benchmark of 17.65x [E5] and an EV/EBITDA of 307.11x versus a sector benchmark of 11.48x [E10]. While the bull leans on non-cyclical stability and sector tailwinds [E18, E27, E28], the company's operational returns are profoundly weak, showing an anemic ROE of 1.1% compared to a sector benchmark of 8.41% [E8] and an ROCE of just 1.38% against a sector median of 9.33% [E9]. Furthermore, the claim of fundamental strength stands in stark contradiction to the massive insider flight where promoters slashed their stake by 44.05 percentage points down to a negligible 2.24% [E15, E21, E22]. Operating with low debt [E19] offers little comfort when the company exhibits inconsistent quarterly operating margins [E14] and trades at an extreme valuation blind-spot of 21.1x book value [E20, E25] with zero dividend yield [E3].
